# Test js/wasm test execution routing under logos test.
# When GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm:
# 1. Default routing resolves $GOROOT/lib/wasm/go_js_wasm_exec when none is in PATH.
# 2. A PATH-provided go_js_wasm_exec takes precedence over the bundled runner.
# 3. Explicit -exec takes precedence over both PATH and bundled runners.
# The runners execute Node to run the WebAssembly test binary.
# Honestly skip if node is unavailable.
[!exec:node] skip 'node is required to run js/wasm test binaries'

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOOS=js
env GOARCH=wasm

# 1. Default routing: executes via bundled $GOROOT/lib/wasm/go_js_wasm_exec.
logos test -v .
stdout '=== RUN   TestWasmExec'
stdout 'WASM_TEST_PASS_OUTPUT'
stdout '--- PASS: TestWasmExec'
stdout '^PASS'
stdout '^ok  \texample\.com/wasmtest'

# 2. Explicit -exec precedence: -exec overrides the bundled runner.
chmod 0755 custom_exec.sh
logos test -v -exec=$PWD/custom_exec.sh .
stdout 'CUSTOM_EXEC_RUNNER_CALLED'
stdout '=== RUN   TestWasmExec'
stdout 'WASM_TEST_PASS_OUTPUT'
stdout '--- PASS: TestWasmExec'
stdout '^PASS'
stdout '^ok  \texample\.com/wasmtest'

# 3. PATH-provided runner precedence: runner in PATH overrides bundled runner.
mkdir $WORK/bin
cp path_exec.sh $WORK/bin/go_js_wasm_exec
chmod 0755 $WORK/bin/go_js_wasm_exec
env PATH=$WORK${/}bin${:}$PATH

logos test -v .
stdout 'PATH_WRAPPER_RUNNER_CALLED'
! stdout 'CUSTOM_EXEC_RUNNER_CALLED'
stdout '=== RUN   TestWasmExec'
stdout 'WASM_TEST_PASS_OUTPUT'
stdout '--- PASS: TestWasmExec'
stdout '^PASS'
stdout '^ok  \texample\.com/wasmtest'

# 4. Explicit -exec precedence over PATH runner: -exec overrides PATH runner.
logos test -v -exec=$PWD/custom_exec.sh .
stdout 'CUSTOM_EXEC_RUNNER_CALLED'
! stdout 'PATH_WRAPPER_RUNNER_CALLED'
stdout '=== RUN   TestWasmExec'
stdout 'WASM_TEST_PASS_OUTPUT'
stdout '--- PASS: TestWasmExec'
stdout '^PASS'
stdout '^ok  \texample\.com/wasmtest'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/wasmtest

go 1.27

-- wasm_test.go --
package wasmtest

import "testing"

func TestWasmExec(t *testing.T) {
	t.Log("WASM_TEST_PASS_OUTPUT")
}

-- custom_exec.sh --
#!/bin/sh
echo "CUSTOM_EXEC_RUNNER_CALLED"
exec "$GOROOT/lib/wasm/go_js_wasm_exec" "$@"

-- path_exec.sh --
#!/bin/sh
echo "PATH_WRAPPER_RUNNER_CALLED"
exec "$GOROOT/lib/wasm/go_js_wasm_exec" "$@"
